capabilities: Draw volleyball drills and tactics on an SVG board
Edit diagrams by clicking the board and saving changes back to the block
Run the same whiteboard as a standalone web app
extras: The README is partly developer-oriented: it documents a shell script to copy build files into a vault and an Italian section on deploying the companion web app to GitHub Pages/Cloudflare, including a note that browser data does not migrate between domains.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to draw interactive volleyball tactical diagrams inside notes.
summary: Tactical volleyball whiteboard that renders SVG drill diagrams from JSON blocks embedded in notes.
